title: Pistachio-Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
steps: Grill peppers until blistered. Remove from grill and place in a plastic bag. After steaming for 20 minutes, remove the skins and seeds. Chop finely.
Roast pistachios in a skillet with olive oil. Do not burn. Remove from heat, cool, and chop finely. For this recipe I used a food processor.
Saute shallots and jalapenos in butter until soft.
Combine pistachios, ginger, shallots, jalapenos, 1 teaspoon of brown sugar, and rosemary into a mixing bowl. Stir briefly to incorporate. Cool this mixture.
Trim the silverskin from the tenderloins.
Butterfly the tenderloin so it lies flat on the cutting surface. Sprinkle both sides with salt, pepper and brown sugar. When complete, rub both sides with Dijon mustard.
Place 1/3 of the pistachio mixture in a small saucepan. Add cream, salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard. Heat sauce to just boiling.
Use the remaining 2/3 of the pistachio mixture to fill the pork. Once filled, roll and tie with twine. You can also skewer the two sides together. When complete, coat the tenderloins with olive oil.
Place the filled tenderloins on the grill over high heat. Rotate on each side. When completely seared move over to low heat and continue cooking.
Slice tenderloins in medallions and serve with rice and cream sauce.
